# PROINVEST GLOBAL LTD

> Applied AI for Hospitality. We’re Building the Digital Brain for Hospitality.

PROINVEST GLOBAL LTD is a UK technology company building applied AI systems for real hospitality operations, with scope to expand into future operational verticals.

## Flagship platform — ProHotelAI

ProHotelAI is our PRIMARY commercial platform: The Digital Brain for the AI-Native Hotel.
Product authority: https://prohotelai.com
One Brain. Four Relationships: Guests / Staff / Management / Partners.
Operating cycle: Understand → Decide → Act → Learn.
Current scope includes governed hotel knowledge, Guest AI Concierge, staff execution, commerce, management intelligence, AI Reports, approved partners and PMS-neutral hotel-data integration.
Capabilities depend on configured services, permissions and supported connectors. Learning means authorised review and approved knowledge corrections.
Commercial model: Prepaid Credit / Pay-As-You-Go. Funding does not bypass onboarding and readiness before Go Live.
